16	// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

18	export interface OnboardingStatus {
19	  studioId: string | null

21	  persona: Persona | null

27	/**
28	 * Returns the requesting IP for rate-limit keying.
29	 * Falls back to 'unknown' when the header is absent (local dev).
30	 */
31	async function getClientIp(): Promise<string> {
32	  const hdrs = await headers()
33	  return hdrs.get('x-forwarded-for') ?? hdrs.get('x-real-ip') ?? 'unknown'
34	}
35	
36	// autoStudioName lives in lib/onboarding/persona.ts — aliased here for local use
37	const autoStudioName = _autoStudioName
38	
39	/**
40	 * Returns a unique slug by appending 4 random hex chars if the given slug
41	 * is already taken by another studio.
42	 */
43	async function resolveUniqueStudioSlug(
44	  supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>,
45	  currentStudioId: string,
46	  slug: string,
47	): Promise<string> {
48	  const { data: conflict } = await supabase
49	    .from('studios')
50	    .select('id')
51	    .eq('slug', slug)
52	    .neq('id', currentStudioId)
53	    .maybeSingle()
54	
55	  if (!conflict) return slug
56	
57	  const suffix = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0xffff)
58	    .toString(16)
59	    .padStart(4, '0')
60	  return `${slug}-${suffix}`
61	}

63	// ─── completeOnboardingWithPersona ────────────────────────────────────────────
64	
65	export async function completeOnboardingWithPersona(
66	  studioId: string,
67	  input: unknown,
68	): Promise<ActionResult<{ redirectTo: string }>> {
69	  const ip = await getClientIp()
70	  const { success: allowed } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
71	  if (!allowed) {
72	    return { ok: false, error: 'Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.' }
73	  }
74	
75	  const supabase = await createClient()
76	  const {
77	    data: { user },
78	    error: authError,
79	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
80	
81	  if (authError || !user) {
82	    return { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated.' }
83	  }
84	
85	  // Validate member is the owner
86	  const { data: member, error: memberError } = await supabase
87	    .from('studio_members')
88	    .select('role')
89	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
90	    .eq('user_id', user.id)
91	    .single()
92	
93	  if (memberError || !member) {
94	    return { ok: false, error: 'Studio not found.' }
95	  }
96	
97	  if (member.role !== 'owner') {
98	    return { ok: false, error: 'Only the studio owner can complete onboarding.' }
99	  }
100	
101	  const parsed = personaPickerSchema.safeParse(input)
102	  if (!parsed.success) {
103	    return { ok: false, error: parsed.error.errors[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' }
104	  }
105	  const data = parsed.data
106	
107	  // Fetch current studio
108	  const { data: currentStudio, error: studioFetchError } = await supabase
109	    .from('studios')
110	    .select('id, name, slug')
111	    .eq('id', studioId)
112	    .single()
113	
114	  if (studioFetchError || !currentStudio) {
115	    logger.error({ studioId, err: studioFetchError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: studio fetch failed')
116	    return { ok: false, error: "We couldn't save your profile. Try again, or refresh the page." }
117	  }
118	
119	  // Auto-derive studio name if still default
120	  const isDefaultName = currentStudio.name === 'My Studio' || !currentStudio.name
121	  const newStudioName = isDefaultName ? autoStudioName(data.fullName) : currentStudio.name
122	
123	  // Compute slug from new name if we're changing it
124	  let finalSlug = currentStudio.slug
125	  if (isDefaultName) {
126	    const rawSlug = slugify(newStudioName)
127	    if (rawSlug && rawSlug !== currentStudio.slug) {
128	      finalSlug = await resolveUniqueStudioSlug(supabase, studioId, rawSlug)
129	    }
130	  }
131	
132	  // Update studio name + slug + timezone + mark onboarded
133	  const { error: studioUpdateError } = await supabase
134	    .from('studios')
135	    .update({
136	      name: newStudioName,
137	      slug: finalSlug,
138	      timezone: data.timezone,
139	      onboarded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
140	    })
141	    .eq('id', studioId)
142	
143	  if (studioUpdateError) {
144	    logger.error({ studioId, err: studioUpdateError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: studio update failed')
145	    return { ok: false, error: "We couldn't save your profile. Try again, or refresh the page." }
146	  }
147	
148	  // Update profile: full_name + onboarding_persona + onboarded_at
149	  const { error: profileUpdateError } = await supabase
150	    .from('profiles')
151	    .update({
152	      full_name: data.fullName,
153	      onboarding_persona: data.persona,
154	      onboarded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
155	    })
156	    .eq('id', user.id)
157	
158	  if (profileUpdateError) {
159	    logger.error({ userId: user.id, err: profileUpdateError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: profile update failed')
160	    // Non-fatal — continue
161	  }
162	
163	  // Upsert artist row (solo_artist persona: user IS the artist)
164	  const { data: existingArtist } = await supabase
165	    .from('artists')
166	    .select('id')
167	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
168	    .eq('profile_id', user.id)
169	    .maybeSingle()
170	
171	  if (existingArtist) {
172	    const { error: artistUpdateError } = await supabase
173	      .from('artists')
174	      .update({ display_name: data.fullName, specialties: [] })
175	      .eq('id', existingArtist.id)
176	
177	    if (artistUpdateError) {
178	      logger.error({ studioId, userId: user.id, err: artistUpdateError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: artist update failed')
179	    }
180	  } else {
181	    const { error: artistInsertError } = await supabase
182	      .from('artists')
183	      .insert({
184	        studio_id: studioId,
185	        profile_id: user.id,
186	        display_name: data.fullName,
187	        specialties: [],
188	      })
189	
190	    if (artistInsertError) {
191	      logger.error({ studioId, userId: user.id, err: artistInsertError }, 'completeOnboardingWithPersona: artist insert failed')
192	    }
193	  }
194	
195	  await logAuditAction(
196	    user.id,
197	    'onboarding.persona_completed',
198	    { type: 'profile', id: user.id },
199	    { persona: data.persona },
200	    studioId,
201	  )
202	
203	  return { ok: true, data: { redirectTo: '/dashboard' } }
204	}
205	
206	// ─── getOnboardingStatus ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
207	
208	export async function getOnboardingStatus(): Promise<OnboardingStatus> {
209	  const supabase = await createClient()
210	
211	  const {
212	    data: { user },
213	    error: authError,
214	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
215	
216	  if (authError || !user) {
217	    return { studioId: null, isOnboarded: false, persona: null, fullName: null }
218	  }
219	
220	  // Fetch studio membership
221	  const { data: memberRow } = await supabase
222	    .from('studio_members')
223	    .select('studio_id, studios(onboarded_at)')
224	    .eq('user_id', user.id)
225	    .is('deactivated_at', null)
226	    .order('joined_at', { ascending: true })
227	    .limit(1)
228	    .single()
229	
230	  if (!memberRow) {
231	    return { studioId: null, isOnboarded: false, persona: null, fullName: null }
232	  }
233	
234	  const studioData = Array.isArray(memberRow.studios)
235	    ? memberRow.studios[0]
236	    : memberRow.studios
237	
238	  const isOnboarded = !!(studioData?.onboarded_at)
239	
240	  const { data: profile } = await supabase
241	    .from('profiles')
242	    .select('full_name, onboarding_persona')
243	    .eq('id', user.id)
244	    .single()
245	
246	  const persona = (profile?.onboarding_persona ?? null) as Persona | null
247	  const fullName = profile?.full_name ?? null
248	
249	  return {
250	    studioId: memberRow.studio_id,
251	    isOnboarded,
252	    persona,
253	    fullName,
254	  }
255	}
256

17

19	
20	export type PersonaPickerInput = z.infer<typeof personaPickerSchema>
21	export type Persona = PersonaPickerInput['persona']

24

26	  | { ok: true; data: T }
27	  | { ok: false; error: string }
